'''Lydea Pagorski''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] officer who served under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. She was called as a witness by the prosecution [[Sul Dekkon]] during the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila]], but her testimony was false and was discredited by defense attorney [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]] by crossreference with surveillance videorecording and she was requested by her own prosecution to remand and wait for her own Trial. At the end of the trial she remained on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until [[Abeloth]]'s takeover and she was chosen as one of Abeloth's host bodies, being absorbed by her. Abeloth used her body and slipped past [[Jagged Fel]]'s blockade against [[Natasi Daala]]. She helped Daala in the Imperial Remnant general election using the force. Abeloth in Pagorski's body captured [[Tahiri Veila]], but [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] freed her, both [[Raid on Hagamoor 3|fighting]] her and Veila managed to use [[Thermal detonator/Legends|Thermal detonators]] to kill Pagorski.
